datasets.name: yr_forecast
queryLines:
-- 연말 예측 시뮬레이션: 연간예산(12개월) vs 1~5월 실적 기반 예측
WITH actual_5m AS (
  SELECT
    `총비용계정`,
    MEASURE(`실적금액`) AS acc_act_5m
  FROM
    wonik_poc.wonik_gold.bgt_expense_metrics
  WHERE
    `기준월` IN ('01', '02', '03', '04', '05')
    AND `총비용계정` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    `총비용계정`
),
annual_plan AS (
  SELECT
    `총비용계정`,
    MEASURE(`예산계획금액`) AS yr_plan
  FROM
    wonik_poc.wonik_gold.bgt_expense_metrics
  WHERE
    `총비용계정` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    `총비용계정`
)
SELECT
  a.`총비용계정`,
  p.`yr_plan`,
  a.`acc_act_5m`,
  a.`acc_act_5m` / 5 AS `monthly_avg`,
  a.`acc_act_5m` / 5 * 12 AS `yr_estimated`,
  a.`acc_act_5m` + (a.`acc_act_5m` / 5 * 1.2 * 7) AS `yr_accel_20`,
  a.`acc_act_5m` / 5 * 12 / NULLIF(p.`yr_plan`, 0) * 100 AS `yr_est_rate`,
  a.`acc_act_5m` / 5 * 12 - p.`yr_plan` AS `yr_surplus_deficit`
FROM
  actual_5m a
    JOIN annual_plan p
      ON a.`총비용계정` = p.`총비용계정`
ORDER BY
  `yr_estimated` DESC

datasets.name: over_budget_alert
queryLines:
-- 초과 집행 계정 경고: 1~5월 실적 vs 1~5월 예산계획 (120% 초과 항목)
-- 최종예산은 연간 기준
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    `표준부서` AS `부서명`,
    `계정명`,
    `총비용계정`,
    MEASURE(`예산계획금액`) AS `plan_amt`,
    MEASURE(`최종예산금액`) AS `final_amt`,
    MEASURE(`실적금액`) AS `act_amt`
  FROM
    wonik_poc.wonik_gold.bgt_expense_metrics
  WHERE
    `기준월` IN ('01', '02', '03', '04', '05')
  GROUP BY
    `표준부서`,
    `계정명`,
    `총비용계정`
),
annual AS (
  SELECT
    `표준부서` AS `부서명`,
    `계정명`,
    MEASURE(`최종예산금액`) AS `annual_final_amt`
  FROM
    wonik_poc.wonik_gold.bgt_expense_metrics
  GROUP BY
    `표준부서`,
    `계정명`
)
SELECT
  m.`부서명`,
  m.`계정명`,
  m.`총비용계정`,
  m.`plan_amt` AS `예산계획_1_5월`,
  a.`annual_final_amt` AS `최종예산_연간`,
  m.`act_amt` AS `실적_1_5월`,
  m.`act_amt` - m.`plan_amt` AS `초과금액_vs계획`,
  m.`act_amt` / NULLIF(m.`plan_amt`, 0) * 100 AS `집행률_vs계획`,
  m.`act_amt` / NULLIF(a.`annual_final_amt`, 0) * 100 AS `집행률_vs연간예산`
FROM
  monthly m
    JOIN annual a
      ON m.`부서명` = a.`부서명`
      AND m.`계정명` = a.`계정명`
WHERE
  m.`plan_amt` > 1000000
  AND m.`act_amt` / NULLIF(m.`plan_amt`, 0) > 1.2
ORDER BY
  `초과금액_vs계획` DESC
LIMIT 50

dimensions.comment: 사업본부 그룹핑 — dept_std 기준 매핑 (6개 카테고리)
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN source.dept_std IN ('COO', 'System본부', '글로벌영업팀', '영업팀', '생산기술팀', '제조팀', '품질G', 'CS팀') THEN 'System본부'
  WHEN source.dept_std IN ('EPC본부', 'EPC사업팀', '건설팀', 'EPC영업팀', 'SDC G', 'Ne Reusing', 'P4 ISO BSGS', 'P5 ISO BSGS') THEN 'EPC본부'
  WHEN source.dept_std IN ('연구소', '신제품개발G', '연구기술G') THEN '연구소'
  WHEN source.dept_std IN ('경영지원본부', '경영인프라혁신TF', '구매팀', '기획팀', '재무팀', '준법G') THEN '경영지원본부'
  WHEN source.dept_std IN ('인사본부(사업부문)', '인사팀', '정보전략팀') THEN '인사본부'
  WHEN source.dept_std IN ('대표이사(사업)', '안전환경경영', '공통', '비서실', 'WT TF') THEN '본사공통'
  ELSE '본사공통'
END
dimensions.name: 사업본부

measures.expr: CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(source.act_amt), 0) > COALESCE(SUM(source.plan_amt), 0) THEN COALESCE(SUM(source.act_amt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(source.plan_amt), 0) ELSE 0 END

datasets.name: monthly_trend_sim
queryLines:
-- 월별 예산(막대) + 실적/예측(선) + 연말 초과 예측
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    `총비용계정`,
    `기준월`,
    MEASURE(`예산계획금액`) AS `월예산`,
    MEASURE(`실적금액`) AS `월실적`
  FROM
    wonik_poc.wonik_gold.bgt_expense_metrics
  WHERE
    `총비용계정` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    `총비용계정`,
    `기준월`
),
avg_calc AS (
  SELECT
    `총비용계정`,
    SUM(`월실적`) / 5 AS `월평균`
  FROM
    monthly
  WHERE
    `기준월` IN ('01', '02', '03', '04', '05')
  GROUP BY
    `총비용계정`
),
annual_plan AS (
  SELECT
    `총비용계정`,
    SUM(`월예산`) AS `연간예산`
  FROM
    monthly
  GROUP BY
    `총비용계정`
)
SELECT
  m.`총비용계정`,
  m.`기준월`,
  m.`월예산`,
  CASE
    WHEN m.`기준월` <= '05' THEN m.`월실적`
    ELSE a.`월평균`
  END AS `월실적_예측`,
  a.`월평균` * 12 - p.`연간예산` AS `연말초과예측`
FROM
  monthly m
    JOIN avg_calc a
      ON m.`총비용계정` = a.`총비용계정`
    JOIN annual_plan p
      ON m.`총비용계정` = p.`총비용계정`
ORDER BY
  m.`총비용계정`,
  m.`기준월`
